chapter.verse: Ni thumna ciangin Galilee gam Cana khua ah mopawi khat om a, Jesu' nu zong tua takah om hi.
Jesu leh a nungzuite zong mopawi ah kisam hi.
Lengtui a bei ciangin Jesu' kiangah a nu in,“Lengtui nei nawnlo uh hi,” ci-in ko hi.
Jesu in, “Numei aw, bangci-a kei hong paikan na hi hiam? Keima' hunlenai hong tung nailo hi,” ci hi.
A nu in zong nasemte' kiangah, “Ama' hong gen bangbang na sem un,” ci hi.
Tua mun ah Jew ngeina kisiansuah nadingin suang tawh kibawl tuibung guk om a, khat ciangin tui gallon sawmnih sawmthum kiim ta hi.
Jesu in nasemte' kiangah, “Tuibungte tui dim un,” ci hi. Nasemte in zong a tungzang dimin dim uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in, “Tu-in tawm suakkhia unla pawi ukpa' kiangah va tawiphei un,” ci hi. Amau zong tawiphei uh hi.
Pawi ukpa in lengtui a suak tui a ciap ciangin koi pan kingah cih (tui a suakkhia nasemte in a theih hangin) amah'n thei lo ahih manin zipi tangvalpa sam a,
“Mi'n lengtui a limte hawm masa uh a, duhzah a kidawn khit ciangin a dauzawte hawm uh hi. Nang'n na hihleh a limte tu ciangdong na koihcing hi,” ci hi.
Jesu in ama' bawl kihilna limte lakah a masapen ahi tu-a pen Galilee gam Cana khua ah a bawl hi a, tu-a bangin ama' minpha kilangsak hi. A nungzuite in zong amah um uh hi.
Tua nungah a nu, a naute leh a nungzuite tawh Capernaum ah Jesu paisuk a, tua takah tawmvei sung taam uh hi.
Jew mite' Paisan Pawi nai ta a, Jesu zong Jerusalem ah pai hi.
Biakinnpi sungah bawng, tuu, vakhu a zuakte leh tua taka a tu sumkhekte mu hi.
Tua ciangin savun khauteep khat bawlin tuu leh bawngte-a kipan amaute a vekun biakinnpi pan hawlkhia hi. Sumkhekte' sumtang teng zong bungkhia-in a sabuaite uh zong sawnpaai hi.
Tua ciangin vakhu zuakte' kiangah, “Hihte paikhiatpih un. Ka Pa' inn sumbuktual suaksak kei un,” ci hi.
A nungzuite in zong, “Na inn ka kinna lungsim in kei hong kangtum ding hi,” ci-a a kigelh thu phawk uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jew mite in, “Hihte na hihtheih nadingin bang kihilna lim hong lak thei na hi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Jesu in, “Hih biakinnpi phelzan un; ni thum sungin ka dingsakkik ding hi,” ci hi.
Jew mite in, “Hih biakinnpi a kilamna kum sawmli-le-guk sawt hi. Nang'n ni thum sungin dingsakkik ding na hi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu' gen pen biakinnpi ahi ama' pumpi ahi hi.
Tua hangin misite' lakpan amah a kithawhkiksak ciangin ama' nungzuite in tu-a a thugen phawk uh a, Pasian' Laibu leh Jesu' thugen um uh hi.
Tu-in Paisan Pawi hun laitak Jerusalem ah Jesu a om sungin mi tampitak in ama' bawl kihilna limte mu uh a, Jesu' min um uh hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu ahihleh mi khempeuh theitel ahih manin kuama' tungah a lungsim pia lo hi.
Mihing' sunga om thu theitel ahih manin ama' adingin mihingte' thu teci a pang ding mi kisam sese lo hi.
